name.ja: ポケモンプラモコレクション BIG 02 イーブイ
name.en: Pokemon plastic model collection BIG 02 Eevee

ja: ポケモンの魅力を詰め込んだ、とにかく大きいプランモデル「ポケプラBIG」第二弾はイーブイ!!
■全48パーツ、全長約20cm。組み立て簡単。最小限のシールで色分け再現。
■いつまでも眺めていたくなるつぶらな瞳をクリアパーツの重ね合わせで表現。
■頭や耳、お尻が左右に可動することで表情豊かなポージングが可能。
■触り心地にもこだわり肉球や舌には軟質素材を採用。
■前脚と首周りの毛が前後に可動することで「タッチ」ポーズが再現可能。
en: The second model of the "Pokepla BIG", a big plan model packed with the charm of Pokemon, is Eevee!!
• Total 48 parts, total length approximately 20cm. Easy assembly. Color-coded reproduction with minimal seals.
• The round eyes that you'll want to stare at forever are expressed by layering clear parts.
• The head, ears, and butt can move left and right, allowing for expressive poses.
• We are particular about the feel of the product, and the paws and tongue are made of soft material.
• "Touch" poses can be recreated by moving the hair around the front legs and neck back and forth.
